name: Sentry MCP (remote)
description: Sentry-hosted remote MCP server (https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp). The same project ships a stdio package @sentry/mcp-server for self-hosted Sentry. Source is under FSL-1.1-ALv2, not an OSI license; licence not recorded on this hosted item.

provenance.notes: Registry entry io.github.getsentry/sentry-mcp version 0.42.0, status active, published 2026-09-25; remotes streamable-http https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp; packages npm @sentry/mcp-server stdio with SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN. Supports version, transport. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).

README: 'Bearer' reserved for MCP OAuth access tokens; 'Sentry-Bearer' forwards an upstream Sentry token that the worker does not validate or refresh; AI search tools need an external LLM provider key. Supports auth_methods (oauth2, api_key). auth_methods records the credential types the server accepts from the client or its environment: oauth2 = MCP authorization (OAuth 2.1) or an upstream OAuth login; api_key = a static bearer/personal/agent token passed by header or environment variable.
